Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. embedding_text_en: Funnel: USE_CASE. Persona traits: comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration. HTML features: missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context; unclear target audience: The intended user role, team, industry, company size, or use case is not explicit; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear.

source_evidence_excerpt: "Exceptional product demos in minutes, not days" / "AI Agents and AI interactive demos that accelerate deals, scale onboarding, and drive product adoption." / CTAs: "Start for free" and "Talk to a human"
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 속도 가치와 팀 단위 활용 가치를 한 화면에서 함께 제시하고, 무료 시작과 상담이라는 두 경로를 동시에 제공한다.

problem_description_en: If a new landing page stacks speed, personalization, team collaboration, and AI-agent promises in the first message, visitors may fail to quickly identify the primary value and lose the thread before scanning further.
structural_issue_cues_ko: 헤드라인과 서브카피에 서로 다른 가치 제안이 동시에 들어감
첫 화면에 CTA가 둘 이상 배치됨
AI Agents, interactive demos, onboarding, adoption 같은 용어가 한 문단에 함께 등장함
structural_issue_cues_en: The headline and subcopy contain multiple value propositions at once
More than one CTA appears above the fold
Terms like AI Agents, interactive demos, onboarding, and adoption appear in the same block
likely_user_traits_ko: 제품 범주를 아직 잘 모르는 평가 초기 방문자
likely_user_traits_en: Cold first-time traffic
Busy B2B buyers scanning quickly
Evaluation-stage visitors who do not yet know the category well
applicable_condition_ko: 히어로가 여러 약속을 동시에 담아 핵심 메시지 우선순위가 흐려질 때 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when the hero packs multiple promises together and the priority of the core message becomes unclear.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 히어로가 단일 문제와 단일 결과를 명확히 강조하고 보조 메시지가 거의 없을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the hero clearly emphasizes one problem and one outcome with little secondary messaging.

퍼널 단계: HERO
구조적 단서: 헤드라인과 서브카피에 서로 다른 가치 제안이 동시에 들어감; 첫 화면에 CTA가 둘 이상 배치됨; AI Agents, interactive demos, onboarding, adoption 같은 용어가 한 문단에 함께 등장함
관련 사용자 특성: 처음 방문한 차가운 트래픽; 짧게 훑어보는 바쁜 B2B 구매자; 제품 범주를 아직 잘 모르는 평가 초기 방문자
관련 행동 양상: quick_exit, shallow_scan, section_stall
적용 조건: 히어로가 여러 약속을 동시에 담아 핵심 메시지 우선순위가 흐려질 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 히어로가 단일 문제와 단일 결과를 명확히 강조하고 보조 메시지가 거의 없을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: "Exceptional product demos in minutes, not days" / "AI Agents and AI interactive demos that accelerate deals, scale onboarding, and drive product adoption." / CTAs: "Start for free" and "Talk to a human"

Funnel section: HERO
Structural cues: The headline and subcopy contain multiple value propositions at once; More than one CTA appears above the fold; Terms like AI Agents, interactive demos, onboarding, and adoption appear in the same block
Relevant user traits: Cold first-time traffic; Busy B2B buyers scanning quickly; Evaluation-stage visitors who do not yet know the category well
Relevant behavior groups: quick_exit, shallow_scan, section_stall
Applicable condition: Apply when the hero packs multiple promises together and the priority of the core message becomes unclear.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the hero clearly emphasizes one problem and one outcome with little secondary messaging.
Source evidence: "Exceptional product demos in minutes, not days" / "AI Agents and AI interactive demos that accelerate deals, scale onboarding, and drive product adoption." / CTAs: "Start for free" and "Talk to a human"

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; risk averse: The visitor is cautious about commitment, switching cost, lock-in, security, or failure; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration. HTML features: missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action.

문제 설명: 이런 식의 한줄 요약이 약하면 방문자는 이 제품이 단순한 채용 게시판인지, ATS인지, 아니면 더 넓은 HR 도구인지 빠르게 구분하지 못한다. 그러면 첫 스크롤 전에 가치 판단이 흐려져 이탈하거나 더 많은 설명을 찾게 된다.
퍼널 단계: HERO
구조적 단서: 헤드라인이 추상적이거나 범주를 설명하지 않음; 서브카피가 기능 나열만 하고 결과를 요약하지 않음; CTA만 있고 제품 정체성이 즉시 드러나지 않음
관련 사용자 특성: 처음 방문한 채용 담당자; ATS와 채용 마케팅 도구를 비교 중인 구매자; 짧게 훑어보는 모바일 방문자
관련 행동 양상: quick_exit, shallow_scan
적용 조건: 히어로에서 제품 범주와 핵심 효용을 한 문장으로 즉시 설명하지 못할 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 제품 범주가 이미 매우 명확하고 방문자가 즉시 무엇을 얻는지 이해할 수 있을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: "Everything you need to hire in one place" / "Publish roles, manage applicants, and make decisions all in one platform." / "Sign up for free"

Funnel section: HERO
Structural cues: headline is abstract or does not explain the category; subcopy only lists features and does not summarize the outcome; CTA exists but the product identity is not immediately clear
Relevant user traits: first-time recruiting visitors; buyers comparing ATS and hiring marketing tools; mobile visitors who scan quickly
Relevant behavior groups: quick_exit, shallow_scan
Applicable condition: Apply when the hero does not immediately explain the product category and core value in one sentence.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the product category is already very clear and visitors can immediately understand the outcome.
Source evidence: "Everything you need to hire in one place" / "Publish roles, manage applicants, and make decisions all in one platform." / "Sign up for free"

canonical_problem_description_en: A problem where multiple modules or features are visible, but their roles and the overall product boundary are unclear. When the suite scope is blurry, visitors cannot easily define fit or comparison criteria.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; risk averse: The visitor is cautious about commitment, switching cost, lock-in, security, or failure; nontechnical user: The visitor is likely not technical and needs accessible product explanation. Behavior symptoms: deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action; missing objection handling: Likely objections or decision questions are not answered near this funnel step.

canonical_problem_description_en: A problem type where it is unclear what category the product belongs to, what problems it solves, and how its scope should be defined, making comparison and fit assessment difficult.

Funnel section: USE_CASE.
HTML structural cues: Use cases are presented only as a generic sentence; Portal types are not enumerated; Menus or tabs exist without concrete work context.
Persona and decision context: Managers seeking a shared platform for multiple teams; Buyers comparing workflow-specific portals; Practitioners narrowing implementation scope.
Behavior symptoms: shallow_scan, section_stall.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. HTML features: missing visual product demo: The section lacks visual product proof such as screenshots, demo frames, interface previews, or output examples; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action; poor information hierarchy: The section does not clearly separate primary message, supporting proof, details, and next action.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. problem_description_en: If a new landing section promises speed but does not clearly show how to try, download, or start, visitors may understand the value yet hesitate about what to click next. The initial interest then fails to convert into action.

제품 사용 방식보다 슬로건이 앞섬

Slogan leads more than product usage guidance

applicable_condition_ko: 상단에서 가치 제안은 강하지만 시작 행동이 하나로 수렴되지 않거나, CTA가 약해 사용자가 다음 단계를 결정하기 어려울 때 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when the top section has a strong value promise but does not converge on a clear start action, or when the CTA is weak and users cannot decide the next step.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 이미 체험, 다운로드, 데모 등 다음 행동이 명확하고 우선순위가 잘 정리되어 있을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the next actions such as trial, download, or demo are already clear and well prioritized.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: unclear next step after CTA: The user cannot predict what happens after clicking the CTA; generic CTA: The CTA text is generic and does not clarify the result or next step after clicking; weak motivation to act: The section gives little reason to act now or continue to the next step.

Persona traits: comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; price sensitive: The visitor is sensitive to price, budget, plan value, or payment commitment; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow. Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. problem_description_en: If this kind of audience-specific transformation promise is missing or weak, visitors may not be able to judge both whether they are the right fit and what improvement they can expect, increasing early drop-off.

Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. HTML features: unclear target audience: The intended user role, team, industry, company size, or use case is not explicit; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; weak value justification: The section asks for money or commitment without clearly explaining the value received.

canonical_problem_description_en: A problem type where setup, pairing, account requirements, start-up steps, or offline use are unclear, making it hard to judge the effort needed to begin.

Persona traits: team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. HTML features: unclear target audience: The intended user role, team, industry, company size, or use case is not explicit; missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear.

Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. raw_problem_description_ko: 이런 식의 수치 증거와 결과 연결이 약하면 방문자는 AI 기능이 실제로 무엇을 얼마나 개선하는지 판단하기 어려워, 기능은 있어도 설득력은 낮은 상태가 된다.
raw_problem_description_en: If this kind of quantified proof and outcome linkage is weak, visitors may struggle to judge what AI actually improves and by how much, leaving the feature present but not persuasive.
canonical_problem_description_ko: 방문자가 서비스나 강의가 실제로 어떤 결과를 만들어 주는지 즉시 이해하지 못하는 문제입니다. 기대 성과가 헤드라인이나 핵심 메시지에서 충분히 구체적으로 드러나지 않을 때 발생합니다.
canonical_problem_description_en: A problem where visitors cannot quickly understand what result the offer helps them achieve. It occurs when the promised outcome is not made concrete enough in the headline or core message.
raw_embedding_text_en:
Retrieval task: diagnose a landing-page problem from input conditions.
Funnel section: FEATURE.
HTML structural cues: AI feature described without outcome numbers; Only abstract innovation language is repeated; Only secondary benefits like branding/customization are shown, not core performance.
Persona and decision context: marketing teams evaluating ROI; growth owners seeking form conversion gains; buyers who need quantified adoption impact.
Behavior symptoms: section_stall, passive_browsing.
Conditional problem: outcome_specificity_gap / Outcome specificity gap for AI value.
Applicable when: Apply to sections that emphasize AI or automation but do not provide enough concrete performance metrics..

HTML 구조적 단서: AI 기능 설명만 있고 결과 수치가 없음; 추상적 혁신 표현만 반복됨; 브랜드/커스터마이즈 같은 보조 이점만 있고 핵심 성과가 없음.

feature_label_mapping_reason: AI features are described, but the concrete outcome and quantified improvement are not made explicit enough.

page_summary_ko: Typeform은 대화형 폼, AI 자동화, 리서치 플로우, 고객 세분화/후속조치를 한 제품 안에서 묶어 보여주며, 응답률·인사이트·전환 성과를 강조하는 랜딩페이지다.
source_evidence_excerpt: “Set up automations that convert and keep customers for you.” / “enrich leads, create segments, and send personalized messages.” / “Trigger personalized workflows from any form submission or contact update.”
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 폼 제출 이후의 세분화, 메시징, 후속조치를 한 흐름으로 보여줘서 단순 수집 도구가 아니라 전환 운영 도구라는 인식을 만든다.
problem_description_ko: 이런 후속 흐름 설명이 약하면 방문자는 폼 제출 이후 무엇이 자동으로 일어나는지, 그리고 그 과정이 실제 매출이나 리드 전환에 어떻게 연결되는지 상상하기 어렵다.
problem_description_en: If the downstream flow explanation is weak, visitors may not be able to imagine what happens automatically after form submission or how that process connects to revenue or lead conversion.
structural_issue_cues_ko: 제출 후 동작이 보이지 않음
세분화, 메시지, 트리거가 분리되어 설명됨
폼과 CRM/마케팅 후속 흐름의 연결이 없음

Segmentation, messaging, and triggers are explained separately
No connection between the form and CRM/marketing follow-up flow
likely_user_traits_ko: 리드 생성과 육성을 함께 보는 GTM 팀
폼 이후 전환율을 높이고 싶은 성장 팀
likely_user_traits_en: GTM teams handling lead generation and nurture
operations owners evaluating automation
growth teams wanting higher post-form conversion
applicable_condition_ko: 폼 이후의 자동화 가치가 핵심인데, 실제 흐름과 결과가 충분히 연결되지 않은 섹션에 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when post-form automation is central but the actual flow and outcome are not sufficiently connected.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 이미 제출 후 단계, 트리거, 결과가 시각적으로 명확한 경우에는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when post-submit steps, triggers, and outcomes are already visually clear.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; technical user: The visitor can evaluate technical details such as APIs, workflows, data, or integrations; founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear.

non_applicable_condition_ko: 이미 히어로나 첫 주요 섹션에서 강한 고객 증거를 제공하는 경우에는 적용하지 않는다.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. HTML features: missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action.

문제 설명: 이런 패턴이 없거나 약하면 방문자는 '빠르다'는 말은 이해해도 무엇부터 해야 하는지, 무료로 시작할지 AI로 시작할지, 어떤 경로가 자신의 상황에 맞는지 판단하기 어렵다. 그 결과 첫 클릭이 지연되고 헤더에서 이탈할 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: HERO
구조적 단서: 헤드라인이 짧고 추상적임; CTA가 하나만 있거나 다음 단계가 드러나지 않음; 속도 주장과 시작 방식이 분리되어 있음
관련 사용자 특성: 처음 방문한 잠재 고객; 노코드 도구를 비교 중인 팀 리더; 빠른 평가를 원하는 바쁜 의사결정자
관련 행동 양상: quick_exit, shallow_scan
적용 조건: 히어로에서 핵심 가치와 첫 행동 경로가 동시에 보이지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 이미 명확한 단일 CTA와 보조 진입 경로가 충분히 설명된 경우에는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: "Build better sites, faster" / "Framer is the site builder trusted by leading startups and Fortune 500 companies." / "Start for free" / "Start with AI"

Applicable condition: Apply when the hero does not show both the core value and the first action path at the same time.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when a clear primary CTA and a supporting entry path are already well explained.

문제 설명: 이런 규모 증거와 제3자 평점이 약하면 방문자는 제품의 검증 수준을 판단하기 어려워, 특히 신규 방문자나 비교 검토 중인 사용자가 신뢰 형성 전에 이탈할 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: SOCIAL_PROOF
구조적 단서: 사용자 수나 고객 수가 없음; G2, Glassdoor 같은 외부 평점이 없음; 커뮤니티/활동 규모가 보이지 않음
관련 사용자 특성: 처음 방문한 잠재 고객; 보안/구매 리스크를 신경 쓰는 의사결정자; 대안 비교 중인 평가자
관련 행동 양상: quick_exit, passive_browsing, shallow_scan
적용 조건: 브랜드 인지도만으로는 신뢰를 만들기 어려운 신규 방문자 구간에 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 이미 강한 브랜드 인지도나 직접 추천이 있는 트래픽에는 우선순위가 낮다.
수집 근거: "Trusted by more than 300,000 leading GTM teams of all sizes." / "4.9" / "40K+ GTME community" / "5.0"

Problem description: If scale proof and third-party ratings are weak, visitors may struggle to judge the product's credibility, and new or comparing users may leave before trust is established.
Funnel section: SOCIAL_PROOF
Structural cues: No user or customer count; No external ratings such as G2 or Glassdoor; No visible community or activity scale
Relevant user traits: First-time visitors; Decision-makers concerned about risk or security; Evaluators comparing alternatives
Relevant behavior groups: quick_exit, passive_browsing, shallow_scan
Applicable condition: Apply for new-visitor segments where brand awareness alone is not enough to build trust.
Non-applicable condition: It is lower priority for traffic that already has strong brand awareness or direct referrals.
Source evidence: "Trusted by more than 300,000 leading GTM teams of all sizes." / "4.9" / "40K+ GTME community" / "5.0"

Persona traits: technical user: The visitor can evaluate technical details such as APIs, workflows, data, or integrations; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns; risk averse: The visitor is cautious about commitment, switching cost, lock-in, security, or failure. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action.

page_summary_ko: Zapier의 메인 랜딩 페이지로, 9,000+ 앱 연결과 AI 워크플로우·에이전트·챗봇을 한 플랫폼에서 구축/관리할 수 있다는 점을 강조한다. 보안, 거버넌스, 대기업/팀별 솔루션, 빠른 셀프서브 시작과 엔터프라이즈 문의 경로를 함께 제시한다.
source_evidence_excerpt: “Start free with email” / “Start free with Google” / “Contact sales” / “start automating in minutes”
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 셀프서브 시작과 세일즈 문의를 함께 제공해, 개인 사용자와 기업 구매자 모두의 전환 경로를 열어둔다.
problem_description_ko: 이런 이중 경로가 약하면, 준비가 덜 된 방문자나 엔터프라이즈 검토자는 적절한 다음 행동을 찾지 못한다. 무료 시작만 있으면 큰 조직은 망설이고, 문의만 있으면 개인/소규모 사용자는 진입 장벽을 느낄 수 있다.
problem_description_en: If this dual-path setup is weak, visitors at different readiness levels cannot find the right next step. Free sign-up alone can make larger organizations hesitate, while contact-only flows can create friction for individuals or small teams.
structural_issue_cues_ko: 무료 시작 CTA가 있음
Contact sales CTA가 함께 있음
빠른 시작을 암시하는 문구가 있음
structural_issue_cues_en: A free-start CTA is present
A Contact sales CTA appears alongside it
Copy implies a quick-start path
likely_user_traits_ko: 도입 단계가 서로 다른 혼합 트래픽
likely_user_traits_en: Individuals or small teams
Enterprise buyers
Mixed traffic with different adoption stages
applicable_condition_ko: 방문자 집단의 구매 성숙도가 다양하고, 한 가지 CTA만으로는 모두를 만족시키기 어려울 때 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when visitor readiness varies and one CTA cannot satisfy all segments.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 단일 세그먼트만 타깃하거나 하나의 전환 방식이 명확히 우세한 경우에는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the page targets a single segment or one conversion mode is clearly dominant.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: CTA_SECTION. Persona traits: individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; small business owner: The visitor runs a small business and values practical ROI and simplicity; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns. Behavior symptoms: interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert; quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration. Problem description: If this use-case context is weak, visitors may understand the feature but still struggle to imagine the real workflow, making adoption feel abstract even after a demo.
Funnel section: USE_CASE
Structural cues: Feature names are listed without work scenarios; No examples of repetitive tasks; Only technical explanation instead of task outcomes
Relevant user traits: Buyers trying to verify real usage after adoption; Team leads evaluating the scope of automation; Practitioners mapping the product to their repetitive work
Relevant behavior groups: section_stall, interaction_without_conversion, deep_engagement_exit
Applicable condition: Apply when feature descriptions exist but the page lacks scenes showing what real work the feature replaces.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when task-specific examples, before/after comparisons, or a concrete demo flow are already provided.

Problem description: If integration and admin-control information is weak, visitors may not be sure the product fits their existing tools or security requirements, which can stall adoption review.
Funnel section: FEATURE
Structural cues: specific connected apps are not visible; SSO or permission management is not mentioned; admin features are not separated from user-facing features
Relevant user traits: IT and security stakeholders; buyers checking compatibility with existing tool stacks; adoption reviewers in large organizations
Relevant behavior groups: section_stall, deep_engagement_exit
Applicable condition: Apply when integration scope and security control are important to the purchase decision but concrete evidence is lacking.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the product is for a single app or the integration and security details are already sufficient.
Source evidence: “Connections” / “Connect your apps” / “Search across Slack, Google Drive, GitHub & more” / “Admin controls” / “SAML SSO” / “Premium connections”

raw_problem_description_en: If integration and admin-control information is weak, visitors may not be sure the product fits their existing tools or security requirements, which can stall adoption review.

canonical_problem_description_en: A problem type where APIs, SDKs, languages, protocols, or integration paths are not shown clearly enough for buyers to judge whether the product fits their existing stack.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: unclear next step after CTA: The user cannot predict what happens after clicking the CTA; generic CTA: The CTA text is generic and does not clarify the result or next step after clicking; weak motivation to act: The section gives little reason to act now or continue to the next step.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. HTML features: feature list without benefits: Features are listed without explaining the user benefit, result, or job each feature supports; unclear category explanation: A low-awareness user may not understand the category, terminology, or what the service actually does; poor information hierarchy: The section does not clearly separate primary message, supporting proof, details, and next action.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: CTA_SECTION. Persona traits: comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting. Problem description: Without this context, visitors may not understand how the template or editor would be used in a real project, so even after seeing the demo they may not imagine adoption.
Funnel section: USE_CASE
Structural cues: Only static images or code snippets are shown, with no user flow; Templates appear as single screens only; Preview and real editing entry points are separated
Relevant user traits: Developers who want to build real app flows quickly; Teams planning to use templates as a product starting point; Evaluators checking adoption potential through demos
Relevant behavior groups: interaction_without_conversion, deep_engagement_exit
Applicable condition: Apply to sections that must persuade through real usage scenes, such as templates, sample apps, or live editors.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply to sections that only need simple feature introduction or conceptual explanation.
Source evidence: "Ready-made multi-page user flows for apps" / "Explore Template" / login-page.tsx preview with editor and live try

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; risk averse: The visitor is cautious about commitment, switching cost, lock-in, security, or failure; individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: missing onboarding reassurance: The section does not reduce concerns about setup, adoption, migration, learning, or time-to-value; missing friction reassurance: The section does not reduce perceived effort, time cost, sales pressure, or commitment around conversion; unclear next step after CTA: The user cannot predict what happens after clicking the CTA.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. HTML features: unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; feature-oriented headline: The main copy reads like product mechanics, features, modules, or category terms rather than user outcomes; weak motivation to act: The section gives little reason to act now or continue to the next step.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. HTML features: unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; feature-oriented headline: The main copy reads like product mechanics, features, modules, or category terms rather than user outcomes; weak motivation to act: The section gives little reason to act now or continue to the next step.

canonical_problem_description_ko: 신뢰를 형성하는 증거가 너무 늦게 제시되어 방문자가 설명을 읽기 전에 먼저 의심을 갖게 되는 문제입니다. 특히 고관여 상품이나 새로운 브랜드에서 초반 신뢰층이 늦으면 이탈이 늘어납니다.
canonical_problem_description_en: A problem where trust-building proof appears too late, so visitors encounter skepticism before they have enough confidence to continue. This is especially harmful for high-consideration offers and newer brands.
raw_embedding_text_en:
Retrieval task: diagnose a landing-page problem from input conditions.
Funnel section: SOCIAL_PROOF.
HTML structural cues: Customer count or logos appear late after the hero; Trust signals are only placed lower on the page; No numeric proof of brand validation.
Persona and decision context: First-time visitors; Buyers evaluating enterprise adoption; Busy visitors who want trust confirmation quickly.
Behavior symptoms: quick_exit, shallow_scan.
Conditional problem: proof_placement_gap / Proof placement gap.
Applicable when: Apply in top-of-page areas where brand familiarity is limited and visitors look for validation signals quickly..
raw_embedding_text_ko:

HTML 구조적 단서: 고객 수나 로고가 히어로 뒤에 늦게 등장함; 신뢰 신호가 하단에만 있음; 브랜드 검증을 보여주는 숫자 증거가 없음.
사용자 특성 및 의사결정 맥락: 처음 방문한 신규 유입 사용자; 엔터프라이즈 도입을 검토하는 구매자; 브랜드 신뢰를 빠르게 확인하려는 바쁜 방문자.
행동 양상: quick_exit, shallow_scan.
조건부 문제: proof_placement_gap / 신뢰 증거 배치가 늦어지는 문제.
적용 조건: 브랜드 인지도만으로 신뢰를 얻기 어렵고, 방문자가 빠르게 검증 신호를 찾는 상단 영역에서 적용한다..
feature_label_mapping_reason: Scale and logo proof arrive too late to establish trust during the first scan.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: VALUE_PROP. Persona traits: low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent. HTML features: generic positioning: The positioning is broad or category-generic and does not explain why this option is different; unclear category explanation: A low-awareness user may not understand the category, terminology, or what the service actually does; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear.

Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. page_summary_ko: Basecamp의 랜딩페이지는 프로젝트 관리의 복잡함을 줄이고, 단순함·신뢰성·장기 운영 실적을 전면에 내세우며 무료 체험으로 유도한다. 홈 화면, 프로젝트 구조, 보고서, 알림, 고객 협업, FAQ를 통해 제품이 실제 업무를 어떻게 정리하는지 구체적으로 보여준다.
source_evidence_excerpt: “10 seconds after you sign up, clarity sets in.” / “The home screen organizes your projects, assignments, and upcoming events together on one screen.”
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 온보딩 결과를 시간 단위로 약속하고, 첫 화면이 무엇을 보여주는지 바로 설명해 초기 사용 장벽을 낮춘다.
problem_description_ko: 신규 입력 섹션에서 사용자가 가입 후 얼마나 빨리 가치를 볼 수 있는지, 첫 화면에서 무엇을 해야 하는지 명확하지 않으면 시작 비용이 커 보인다. 그러면 방문자는 '설치하고 배워야 하는 도구'로 인식해 체험을 미룰 수 있다.
problem_description_en: If a new section does not make clear how quickly users will see value after signup or what they should do on the first screen, the start-up cost feels high. Visitors may then see the product as something they have to install and learn before it helps.
structural_issue_cues_ko: 가입 직후 상태를 보여주는 설명이 없음
첫 화면의 역할이 추상적으로만 표현됨
초기 사용 단계나 첫 행동이 보이지 않음
structural_issue_cues_en: No description of the post-signup state
The role of the first screen is only described abstractly
No early usage step or first action is visible
likely_user_traits_ko: 도입 교육 시간을 줄이고 싶은 운영 담당자
새 툴 학습에 민감한 비전문 사용자
likely_user_traits_en: Busy team leads
Operations owners who want to reduce training time
Non-expert users sensitive to learning new tools
applicable_condition_ko: 제품의 첫 사용 경험이 빠르고 단순하다는 점을 보여줘야 하는데, 그 속도와 초기 행동이 불분명할 때 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when the page needs to show that first-use experience is fast and simple, but the speed and initial actions are unclear.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 가입 후 즉시 보이는 화면, 시간 약속, 첫 행동이 충분히 구체적으로 제시될 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the post-signup screen, time promise, and first action are already described concretely.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; nontechnical user: The visitor is likely not technical and needs accessible product explanation; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing onboarding reassurance: The section does not reduce concerns about setup, adoption, migration, learning, or time-to-value; insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; unclear next step after CTA: The user cannot predict what happens after clicking the CTA.

문제 설명: 이런 패턴이 약하면 방문자는 어떤 수준까지 커스터마이즈할 수 있는지, 무엇이 기본값이고 무엇이 제어 가능한지 판단하기 어려워 도입 가능성을 과소평가할 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: FEATURE
구조적 단서: 기능 설명이 추상적이고 설정 항목이 보이지 않음; 모델/프롬프트/정책 같은 구체적 제어점이 없음; 제품이 '커스터마이즈 가능'하다고만 말하고 범위를 보여주지 않음
관련 사용자 특성: 구현 담당자; 보안/법무 검토가 필요한 팀; 운영 정책을 세밀하게 맞춰야 하는 B2B 구매자
관련 행동 양상: section_stall, passive_browsing
적용 조건: 기능 섹션에서 제어 가능한 항목과 설정 범위가 충분히 드러나지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 설정 항목, 예시, 제어 수준이 구체적으로 나열될 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: "Model Select..." / "Prompt" / "Force users to submit contact info" / "Include custom privacy policy" / "Show splash screen on new chats"
llm_context_en:
Problem type: Configuration scope becomes ambiguous (configuration_scope_ambiguity)
Problem description: If this pattern is weak, visitors may struggle to judge how much can be customized, what is default, and what is controllable, which can cause them to underestimate adoption feasibility.
Funnel section: FEATURE
Structural cues: Feature copy is abstract and no settings are visible; No concrete control points such as model, prompt, or policy; The page only says it is customizable without showing scope
Relevant user traits: Implementation owners; Teams needing security or legal review; B2B buyers who must tune operational policy closely
Relevant behavior groups: section_stall, passive_browsing
Applicable condition: Apply when the feature section does not clearly expose controllable items and configuration scope.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when settings, examples, and control levels are clearly enumerated.
Source evidence: "Model Select..." / "Prompt" / "Force users to submit contact info" / "Include custom privacy policy" / "Show splash screen on new chats"

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert. HTML features: missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples.

Persona traits: price sensitive: The visitor is sensitive to price, budget, plan value, or payment commitment; risk averse: The visitor is cautious about commitment, switching cost, lock-in, security, or failure; individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use. Behavior symptoms: interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. problem_description_en: If the launch timing, location, and invitation framing are weak, visitors may not immediately understand when and where the venue opens, making interest less likely to turn into action.

applicable_condition_ko: 런칭형 랜딩에서 오픈 시점과 지역성이 첫 화면에서 충분히 드러나지 않을 때 적용한다.

non_applicable_condition_ko: 이미 첫 화면에서 도시, 오픈 예정, 초대/대기자 CTA가 명확하면 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the first screen already makes the city, launch timing, and invitation/waitlist CTA explicit.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement. HTML features: missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; generic positioning: The positioning is broad or category-generic and does not explain why this option is different.

문제 설명: 이런 시나리오 구분이 약하면, 방문자는 자신에게 가장 맞는 이용 장면을 찾지 못해 페이지가 넓게 보이지만 기억에는 남지 않을 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: FEATURE
구조적 단서: 가족/친구/기업팀 등 시나리오 구분이 없음; 행사 유형이 한 덩어리로만 제시됨; 각 시나리오별 혜택이 다르지 않음
관련 사용자 특성: 여러 이용 목적 중 하나를 고르는 방문자; 단체 예약을 검토하는 사람; 행사 장소를 비교하는 기획자
관련 행동 양상: passive_browsing, section_stall
적용 조건: 활용 사례가 많지만 각 사례의 차이가 충분히 드러나지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 핵심 시나리오가 1~2개로 선명하게 정리되어 있으면 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: « Moments en famille », « Soirées entre amis », « Anniversaires & célébrations » / « Afterworks, séminaires ou team buildings » / « Networking original »
llm_context_en:
Problem type: Use-case multiplicity blur (use_case_multiplicity_blur)
Problem description: If use-case distinctions are weak, visitors may not find the scenario that best fits them, making the page feel broad but not memorable.
Funnel section: FEATURE
Structural cues: No separation between family/friends/corporate scenarios; Event types are presented as one lump; No differentiated benefit per scenario
Relevant user traits: Visitors choosing among multiple use purposes; People evaluating group bookings; Planners comparing event venues
Relevant behavior groups: passive_browsing, section_stall
Applicable condition: Apply when there are many use cases but the differences between them are not sufficiently clear.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the core scenarios are already clearly narrowed to one or two.
Source evidence: « Moments en famille », « Soirées entre amis », « Anniversaires & célébrations » / « Afterworks, séminaires ou team buildings » / « Networking original »

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context.

적용 조건: 페이지가 특정 업무 단계의 문제를 해결한다고 주장하지만 그 단계가 본문에서 반복되지 않을 때

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Behavior symptoms: interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: weak motivation to act: The section gives little reason to act now or continue to the next step; generic CTA: The CTA text is generic and does not clarify the result or next step after clicking; unclear conversion-entry value: The value of starting signup, demo request, waitlist, contact, or form entry is unclear.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting. HTML features: insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; missing objection handling: Likely objections or decision questions are not answered near this funnel step; weak value justification: The section asks for money or commitment without clearly explaining the value received.

Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting; passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent. 문제 설명: 이런 가치 전환이 약하면, 방문자는 작품의 분위기는 느끼지만 왜 이 이야기를 읽어야 하는지 명확히 이해하지 못할 수 있다. 결과적으로 감상용 소개로는 남지만 선택 이유가 약해진다.
퍼널 단계: VALUE_PROP
구조적 단서: 주제어는 있으나 독자가 얻는 감정적/서사적 보상이 구체적이지 않음; 차별점이 분위기 수준에 머무름; 혜택보다 묘사가 앞섬
관련 사용자 특성: 읽을 가치와 감정적 보상을 비교하는 독자; 추천 페이지에서 선택 이유를 찾는 방문자; 비슷한 작품 사이에서 차이를 찾는 사용자
관련 행동 양상: passive_browsing, section_stall
적용 조건: 작품의 주제와 톤은 보이지만, 독자가 얻을 구체적 보상이나 차별점이 명확하지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 독자가 얻는 감정적 보상, 서사적 긴장, 차별점이 명확히 제시될 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: “It’s a story about what’s left behind. About survival, memory, and the cruel kind of magic that doesn’t look like magic at all.”
llm_context_en:
Problem type: What the reader gets from the story can remain underspecified (outcome_specificity_gap)
Problem description: If this value translation is weak, visitors may feel the mood but not understand why they should choose the story. The page then reads as an atmospheric introduction rather than a persuasive reason to read.
Funnel section: VALUE_PROP
Structural cues: Themes are present but the reader's emotional or narrative payoff is not concrete; Differentiation stays at the mood level; Description outweighs benefit framing
Relevant user traits: Readers comparing emotional payoff and value; Visitors looking for a reason to choose from a recommendation page; Users distinguishing between similar works
Relevant behavior groups: passive_browsing, section_stall
Applicable condition: Apply when the story's theme and tone are visible but the concrete payoff or differentiator for the reader is unclear.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the emotional payoff, narrative tension, and differentiator are clearly stated.
Source evidence: “It’s a story about what’s left behind. About survival, memory, and the cruel kind of magic that doesn’t look like magic at all.”

raw_problem_description_ko: 이런 갈등 설명이 약하면, 방문자는 주인공이 왜 중요한지, 무엇이 문제인지, 어떤 감정선으로 읽어야 하는지 파악하는 데 더 많은 노력을 써야 한다. 그러면 서사 몰입 전에 해석 피로가 먼저 온다.
raw_problem_description_en: If this conflict explanation is weak, visitors must spend more effort figuring out why the protagonist matters, what the problem is, and how to read the emotional arc. Interpretation fatigue can arrive before immersion.
canonical_problem_description_ko: 설정, 연동, 계정 요구사항, 시작 절차, 오프라인 사용 가능 여부 등이 분명하지 않아 시작에 필요한 노력을 가늠하기 어려운 문제 유형입니다.
canonical_problem_description_en: A problem type where setup, pairing, account requirements, start-up steps, or offline use are unclear, making it hard to judge the effort needed to begin.
raw_embedding_text_en:

Funnel section: FEATURE.
HTML structural cues: The protagonist's limitation is not summarized in one sentence; Cause and effect of emotional change are separated; No repeated core-conflict line.

source_evidence_excerpt: “Revolutionize Your Wellness Routine” / “the first-ever wellness smart home and 360° wellness app” / brand partners like Calm, FitOn, Meditopia, Technogym
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 헤드라인과 서브카피가 ‘웰니스 루틴 혁신’이라는 결과 중심 메시지와 파트너 브랜드 신뢰를 함께 제시해, 첫 화면에서 제품 범주와 기대효과를 빠르게 이해시키고 있다.
problem_description_ko: 이처럼 첫 화면에서 결과, 제품 범주, 신뢰 브랜드를 빠르게 연결하지 못하면 방문자는 이 서비스가 무엇을 바꾸는지와 왜 지금 봐야 하는지를 즉시 파악하지 못해 이탈할 수 있다.
problem_description_en: If the hero does not quickly connect outcome, product category, and trust brands, visitors may not immediately understand what the service changes or why it matters now, increasing the chance of exit.

likely_user_traits_en: First-time visitors
Mobile visitors who scan quickly
Decision-makers who need to understand both wellness and smart-home concepts
applicable_condition_ko: 첫 화면에서 핵심 가치와 카테고리, 신뢰 근거가 한 번에 연결되지 않을 때 적용한다.

non_applicable_condition_ko: 첫 화면에서 결과와 제품 정체성, 파트너 신뢰가 명확하게 동시에 제시될 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the first screen clearly presents the outcome, product identity, and partner trust at the same time.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: USE_CASE. Persona traits: low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. HTML features: missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context; insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; unclear target audience: The intended user role, team, industry, company size, or use case is not explicit.

problem_description_en: If partner logos are shown without explaining what each partner enables, visitors may not be able to judge the real integration scope or compatibility, creating trust without certainty.
structural_issue_cues_ko: 로고 캐러셀은 있으나 역할 설명이 없음

likely_user_traits_en: Users checking compatibility with existing smart-home or wellness stacks
Operators doing technical review before adoption

applicable_condition_ko: 파트너 로고는 많지만 각 파트너의 역할, 연동 방식, 호환 범위가 설명되지 않을 때 적용한다.

non_applicable_condition_ko: 파트너별 기능과 연동 범위가 명확히 매핑되어 있을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when partner functions and integration scope are clearly mapped.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: technical user: The visitor can evaluate technical details such as APIs, workflows, data, or integrations; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns; trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action; insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation.

수집 근거: Repeated “Apply Now” CTA in the nav and hero, plus closing conversion emphasis implied by the application flow

Problem description: If this repeated CTA is weak, visitors may lose track of where to apply later even after becoming interested, missing the conversion opportunity.
Funnel section: CTA_SECTION
Structural cues: CTA appears only once; Top and body CTA copy differs; Application link is not prominent; No action summary at the end
Relevant user traits: Visitors who read multiple sections and return; Visitors who act after comparison review; Deferred visitors planning to apply later
Relevant behavior groups: passive_browsing, deep_engagement_exit
Applicable condition: Apply when visitors may browse multiple sections and then struggle to find the application path again.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the application path is already clear and memorable across multiple points.
Source evidence: Repeated “Apply Now” CTA in the nav and hero, plus closing conversion emphasis implied by the application flow

문제 설명: 새 섹션에서 다루는 주제가 너무 넓거나 추상적이면 사용자는 자신의 고민이 여기서 해결될지 판단하기 어렵고, 커뮤니티의 실용성이 약해 보일 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: USE_CASE
구조적 단서: 주제 목록이 없음; 주제가 업계 일반어만 사용함; 실제 상황이나 고민 시나리오가 없음; 대화 범위가 너무 포괄적임
관련 사용자 특성: 특정 고민을 가진 방문자; 포트폴리오, 고객, 경력 문제를 해결하려는 사용자; 자기 문제와 맞는 커뮤니티를 찾는 사용자
관련 행동 양상: passive_browsing, section_stall
적용 조건: 주제나 사용 사례가 추상적이어서 방문자가 자기 문제와 연결하기 어려울 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 구체적인 고민, 상황, 질문 예시가 충분히 제시될 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: “We talk about Red Flags, Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, Client Struggle, Portfolio Building, Webflow Secrets, Staying Motivated”
llm_context_en:
Problem type: Topic scope uncertainty (topic_scope_uncertainty)
Problem description: If the topics covered in a new section are too broad or abstract, users may struggle to tell whether their own problems will be addressed, and the community can seem less practical.
Funnel section: USE_CASE
Structural cues: No topic list; Topics use only generic industry terms; No real-world situations or problem scenarios; Conversation scope is overly broad
Relevant user traits: Visitors with specific concerns; Users trying to solve portfolio, client, or career issues; Users looking for a community that matches their problem
Relevant behavior groups: passive_browsing, section_stall
Applicable condition: Apply when topics or use cases are abstract enough that visitors cannot connect them to their own problem.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when concrete concerns, situations, or question examples are sufficiently provided.
Source evidence: “We talk about Red Flags, Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, Client Struggle, Portfolio Building, Webflow Secrets, Staying Motivated”

embedding_text_en: Funnel: CTA_SECTION. Persona traits: time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value; individual user: The visitor is buying or evaluating for personal or solo use; founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage. embedding_text_en: Funnel: USE_CASE. Persona traits: team buyer: The visitor is buying or evaluating for a team or shared workflow; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent. canonical_problem_description_en: A problem type where setup, pairing, account requirements, start-up steps, or offline use are unclear, making it hard to judge the effort needed to begin.
raw_embedding_text_en:
Retrieval task: diagnose a landing-page problem from input conditions.
Funnel section: FAQ.
HTML structural cues: usage instructions appear only in FAQ with no steps; setup time, difficulty, or required skills are not explained; manual is not specific enough to reduce pre-purchase anxiety.
Persona and decision context: practitioners weighing implementation time and cost; small teams with limited development/design resources; visitors who need to apply the product immediately after purchase.
Behavior symptoms: section_stall, deep_engagement_exit.
Conditional problem: onboarding_effort_ambiguity / Onboarding effort ambiguity.
Applicable when: Apply to digital products or template pages where implementation effort strongly affects purchase decisions..

problem_description_en: If this pattern is weak, visitors may not quickly understand what is being offered, whether it is online or live, and whether it is hands-on, which can cause early scan-stage drop-off.

CTA가 오퍼 이해보다 먼저 노출됨

non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when the offer name, format, and participation mode are already very clear and do not need repetition.

문제 설명: 이런 패턴이 약하면 방문자는 자동화가 어떤 순서로 작동하는지 상상하기 어려워, 기능이 많아 보여도 실제 사용 장면을 떠올리지 못할 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: USE_CASE
구조적 단서: 단계가 아닌 긴 설명문만 있음; 입력과 출력의 연결이 보이지 않음; 실행 순서나 상태 변화가 드러나지 않음
관련 사용자 특성: 도입 후 운영 방식을 검토하는 실무자; 자동화 툴의 설정 난이도를 가늠하는 구매자; 팀 내 교육/전달을 고려하는 관리자
관련 행동 양상: section_stall, deep_engagement_exit
적용 조건: 제품이 여러 단계의 자동화나 조건 분기를 포함하지만 그 순서가 시각적으로 정리되지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 단계 흐름이 이미 명확한 다이어그램이나 인터랙션으로 보여질 때는 적용하지 않는다.

llm_context_en:
Problem type: Workflow mental model gap (workflow_mental_model_gap)
Problem description: If this pattern is weak, visitors may struggle to imagine the sequence of automation, so the product can feel feature-rich but not concrete.
Funnel section: USE_CASE
Structural cues: Only long prose is shown instead of steps; The link between input and output is unclear; Execution order or state changes are not visible
Relevant user traits: Practitioners evaluating post-adoption operations; Buyers estimating automation setup difficulty; Managers considering team training and handoff
Relevant behavior groups: section_stall, deep_engagement_exit
Applicable condition: Apply when the product includes multi-step automation or conditional branching but the sequence is not visually organized.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when the step flow is already clear through diagrams or interactions.
Source evidence: “From intents to outreach. Automatically.”, “Signal detected → Lead captured → Auto-enriched → AI-filtered → Campaign triggered → Reply managed”, “20 intent triggers. Built-in enrichment. Multi-step campaigns. Unified lead management. One login.”

Behavior symptoms: shallow scanning: The visitor scans lightly with limited depth or low engagement; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. 문제 설명: 이런 대상 명시가 약하면 개발자, 디자이너, 초보자, 숙련자 중 누구를 위한 제안인지 흐려져 메시지 적합성이 떨어질 수 있다.
퍼널 단계: TARGET
구조적 단서: 타깃 직군이나 숙련도 표기가 없음; 커뮤니티/교육/이벤트 설명이 모두 같은 톤으로 섞임; 자격 요건이나 적합한 사용자에 대한 안내가 부족함
관련 사용자 특성: 자신이 적합한 대상인지 확인하려는 방문자; 역할 기반으로 콘텐츠를 고르는 사용자; 초보/중급/전문가 중 어디에 속하는지 비교하는 사용자
관련 행동 양상: shallow_scan, section_stall
적용 조건: 페이지가 특정 직군, 수준, 또는 역할을 겨냥하지만 그 구분이 초반에 드러나지 않을 때 적용한다.
비적용 조건: 대상과 수준이 명확히 분리되어 있고, 방문자가 자신의 적합성을 즉시 판단할 수 있을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
수집 근거: “for website developers and designers” / “A Witty, and Upbeat place for Webflow Developers to learn, share knowledge and network”
llm_context_en:
Problem type: Audience segmentation ambiguity (audience_segmentation_ambiguity)
Problem description: If audience cues are weak, it becomes unclear whether the page is for developers, designers, beginners, or advanced users, which reduces message fit.
Funnel section: TARGET
Structural cues: No explicit role or skill-level targeting; Community, education, and event descriptions are mixed in the same tone; Little guidance on qualification or fit
Relevant user traits: visitors checking whether they are the right audience; users selecting content by role; users comparing whether they are beginner, intermediate, or expert
Relevant behavior groups: shallow_scan, section_stall
Applicable condition: Apply when the page targets a specific role, level, or audience but that distinction is not visible early.
Non-applicable condition: Do not apply when audience and skill level are clearly separated and visitors can immediately judge fit.
Source evidence: “for website developers and designers” / “A Witty, and Upbeat place for Webflow Developers to learn, share knowledge and network”

embedding_text_en: Funnel: VALUE_PROP. Persona traits: comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; founder operator: The visitor is a founder or operator seeking growth, speed, or leverage; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: unclear value proposition: The section does not quickly make the core user outcome or value clear; feature list without benefits: Features are listed without explaining the user benefit, result, or job each feature supports; insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FEATURE. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation. Behavior symptoms: passive browsing: The visitor views the section without notable clicks or conversion intent; stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction. HTML features: insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; missing use-case context: The section lacks concrete use cases, scenarios, jobs-to-be-done, or role-specific context.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: SOCIAL_PROOF. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; enterprise buyer: The visitor represents a larger organization with procurement, security, or scale concerns; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation. Behavior symptoms: quick exit: The visitor leaves quickly before meaningful exploration; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing social proof: The section lacks customer proof, testimonials, logos, metrics, reviews, or representative examples; missing credibility marker: The section lacks concrete credibility markers such as customer count, named customer, certification, track record, or expert identity; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action.

source_evidence_excerpt: “An Elevated Cannabis Experience” / “XShack is your go-to app for cannabis lovers and dispensaries, offering easy shopping, data-driven insights, and smart navigation.” / “Shop your way. Grow your business. Meet your new cannabis wingman.”
observed_positive_pattern_ko: 헤드라인, 서브카피, 보조 카피가 함께 있어 앱의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 요약하고, 사용자와 디스펜서 양쪽의 이점을 동시에 제시한다.
problem_name_en: Value proposition without a clear action path
problem_description_ko: 이런 식의 요약형 가치 제안이 약하면 방문자는 이 서비스가 정확히 무엇을 해결하는지, 가장 중요한 한 가지 효익이 무엇인지 빠르게 파악하지 못해 이탈할 수 있다. 특히 앱, 커뮤니티, 쇼핑, 인사이트, 내비게이션이 한 문단에 섞이면 우선순위가 흐려진다.
problem_description_en: If this kind of summary value proposition is weak, visitors may not quickly understand what the service primarily solves or what the single most important benefit is. When app, community, shopping, insights, and navigation are mixed in one block, the priority can become unclear.
structural_issue_cues_ko: h1과 서브카피가 있으나 효익이 여러 개로 분산됨
app, shopping, insights, smart navigation 같은 복수 가치가 한 문장에 병렬로 제시됨
보조 문구가 짧고 구체적 차별점이 적음
structural_issue_cues_en: An h1 and subcopy are present, but the benefits are spread across multiple ideas
Multiple values such as app, shopping, insights, and smart navigation are presented in one sentence
Supporting copy is short and lacks a concrete differentiator
likely_user_traits_ko: 대마초 앱과 디스펜서 솔루션을 동시에 평가하는 방문자
likely_user_traits_en: First-time visitors
Users trying to confirm the product identity quickly
Visitors evaluating both a cannabis app and a dispensary solution
applicable_condition_ko: 히어로에서 여러 효익이 동시에 제시되지만 우선순위나 대표 효익이 분명하지 않을 때 적용한다.
applicable_condition_en: Apply when the hero presents multiple benefits at once but does not clearly prioritize a primary benefit.
non_applicable_condition_ko: 대표 효익이 하나로 강하게 고정되고 나머지는 보조 설명으로 정리되어 있을 때는 적용하지 않는다.
non_applicable_condition_en: Do not apply when one primary benefit is strongly foregrounded and the rest are clearly secondary.
embedding_text_en: Funnel: HERO. Persona traits: low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; time constrained: The visitor needs quick scanning and fast time-to-value. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; interaction without conversion: The visitor clicks, focuses a field, or interacts but does not convert; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing objection handling: Likely objections or decision questions are not answered near this funnel step; missing risk reversal: The section lacks reassurance such as free trial, no credit card, refund, cancellation, privacy, or security; weak trust signal: Credibility, safety, expertise, or proof signals are weak for the requested action.

observed_positive_pattern_ko: FAQ를 통해 기본 개념과 기능 범위를 질문 형식으로 재확인해, 마지막 의문을 해소하도록 설계되어 있습니다.
problem_description_ko: 이런 질문형 보강이 없으면 방문자는 플러그인이 정확히 무엇인지, 어떤 기능이 포함되는지, 더 자세한 설명이 어디 있는지 알기 어려워 구매 직전에서 멈출 수 있습니다.
problem_description_en: Without this question-based reinforcement, visitors may struggle to understand exactly what the plugin is, what is included, and where to find more detail, causing them to stall near conversion.

embedding_text_en: Funnel: FAQ. Persona traits: trust sensitive: The visitor needs credibility, proof, safety, or authority signals before acting; comparison oriented: The visitor is comparing alternatives and needs clear differentiation; low awareness: The visitor has limited category or product awareness and needs a plain explanation. Behavior symptoms: stalling within a section: The visitor stays repeatedly in the same section, suggesting uncertainty or friction; deep engagement followed by exit: The visitor scrolls or stays deeply but exits without converting. HTML features: missing objection handling: Likely objections or decision questions are not answered near this funnel step; insufficient product context: The section does not provide enough concrete product usage context, examples, outputs, or workflow explanation; unclear category explanation: A low-awareness user may not understand the category, terminology, or what the service actually does.
